remarks: Stunning Custom Built Colonial by Chris Montanaro of Redcoat Homes. Designed by Renowned Architect, Judith Larson. This Home Exudes Sophistication, every detail has been meticulously crafted to offer extraordinary living experience on a 1.10 flat manicured acre. Over 8,000 SQ FT w 8-inch wide plank wht oak floors throughout. 1st FL features a Chef's dream kitchen, generous Dining & Family room that share a dual fireplace, spectacular movie theater, 2 Private Offices. The 2nd FL features a Lg primary suite w a spa inspired bath w luxurious heated floors, a separate guest suite,4 additional bedrooms all ensuite in total. Lower level boasts LG Family room, 6th bedroom ensuite & gym, possible additional kitchen for in laws or nanny suite. A few favorite details include; *Kitchen, prepare to unleash your inner gourmet with 6 burner stove featuring a 25,000 BTU power burner, 22" griddle, 3 ovens , coffee bar, and bar area. *Custom-designed movie theater, Dolby Atmos certified system with 13 speakers & dual subwoofers. Sound proof doors w an automatic drop-down seal ensuring a flawless viewing experience. *Mudroom floor has hydro floor heating to keep your toes toasty. *Outside a covered patio/outdoor kitchen 80,000 BTU wok & 2 additional traditional burners, Hestan gas grill, and pizza oven. 3 Season Porch w ceiling heaters for cooler seasons creating a cozy ambiance around the outdoor Fireplace. approved pool site. 200k credit applied to offers towards adding a pool.
